secured: Day secured means you've completed your daily goal for the 7K Steps challenge and locked in your progress for today.
freeze: The app never explained what a freeze is, so I can't say.
selfReported: Self-reported means you manually entered or confirmed your step count yourself rather than it being automatically tracked.
